items.text: Christina Aguilera's concert and the Off Limits music festival in Abu Dhabi have been canceled. The organizers did not provide a reason for the cancellation but promised ticket refunds. These cancellations occurred following increased attacks by the Islamic Republic on Emirati ships and a missile attack on the UAE.

Pro-government groups have asked citizens to sacrifice sheep for the health of Mojtaba Khamenei. Each sheep is valued at 25 million tomans. Citizens have criticized the payment of this cost given the economic situation.
A number of municipal workers in Bandar Mahshahr went on strike due to unpaid wages and livelihood issues. The strike took place in recent days. Official media have reported the end of this strike.
Abdollah Pashabadi, a citizen of Kermanshah, remains detained in Dizelabad prison after 25 days without a decision. His case is still unresolved. This news was reported by Harana News Agency.

The audio version of the Titraval program with Niusha Saremi has been released. The program discusses the attack on the UAE and attacks on targets in Europe. It also addresses the possibility of war expansion in Tehran.
A group of workers from Chabahar Municipality and the engineering company Arg-o-P reported wage arrears and non-payment of insurance and severance pay.

Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, Qatar's Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, met with Faisal bin Farhan, Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister, in Riyadh to discuss regional developments and efforts to reduce tensions. Both sides emphasized continued coordination and resolving disputes through diplomatic means. They also stressed the importance of security and freedom of navigation in the Persian Gulf and the Red Sea.

Mehdi Tartaar stated after Persepolis's 4-1 victory over Esteghlal Khuzestan that the team is ahead of its goals and needs reinforcement in one position. He requested the club management to sign players before the transfer window. Tartaar also commented on the players' performance and the need to work more with young players.

Heavy rainfall caused flooding and landslides in Tocopilla, Antofagasta province, Chile. The Chilean president declared a state of constitutional disaster in the province. The National Office of Emergency of Chile issued a red alert for several cities.

The French government expelled Niloufar Shadmehri, the cultural attaché of the Iranian embassy. This action was in response to Iran expelling two French embassy staff members. The name and position of the second expelled individual from France have not yet been announced.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the governor of the Central Bank of Iran, said in a televised interview that income restrictions due to reduced oil exports are a widespread issue affecting neighboring countries including Qatar and Iraq. He stated that Iran's main difference is the lack of access to foreign reserves because they have been blocked by the United States. Hemmati added that the simultaneous decline in oil, tax, and social security premium revenues has impacted all economic sectors.

Pouria Hosseini-Mofrad, detained during the December 2025 protests, was sentenced to death by the Mashhad Revolutionary Court. His charges include acting against national security and conspiracy. He has been held in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad since January 14, 2026.

The execution of a prisoner convicted of drug-related crimes was carried out in Dastgerd prison, Isfahan. Additionally, a prisoner sentenced to death in Kouhrang was spared from execution after the victim's family pardoned him. These events occurred on August 19.

Donald Trump stated that the naval blockade against Iran has been 100 percent successful and no ships have entered Iran. He also said that we might see the most impactful sanctions against Iran this week. Trump added that the Strait of Hormuz will no longer be as important as it was in the past.

The Axios website reported that the US military has created a shipping route under its control in the southern part of the Strait of Hormuz. This route enables the daily transport of millions of barrels of oil, and according to US officials, about 15 to 20 tankers pass through it each night. The average daily oil transfer through this route has reached nearly 10 million barrels.

Saudi Arabia has asked the Iraqi Prime Minister to arrest and punish the leaders of militias supported by the Islamic Republic involved in attacks on Saudi Arabia. Riyadh emphasized that the leaders who ordered the attacks, not just the forces who carried them out, should be held accountable. This report was published by Al-Monitor citing regional officials.

Morad Veysi, a senior analyst at Iran International, quoted a famous poem attributed to Ferdowsi about Iranian patriotism. He stated that the actions of the Islamic Republic officials are completely opposite to this poem. He added that these officials believe "If we are not there, Iran should not be either."

Fars news agency reported the seizure of an Emirati oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. This occurred after Iran fired two ballistic missiles towards Emirati waters. Abu Dhabi has suspended all trade and financial transactions with Iran.

Images from Wednesday, 28 Mordad, captured the moment of the attack on the city of Zhytomyr, Ukraine. Local officials reported at least two people killed in the attack. The attack targeted the regional police headquarters.

Donald Trump said he might negotiate with Tehran in the future but currently sees no need for immediate talks. Meanwhile, it was reported that the US military is transporting about 10 million barrels of oil daily from south of the Strait of Hormuz to the global market. This report was published by Amir Giti from Iran International.

Shayan Samiei said that an attack by the Islamic Republic on US bases in a NATO member country crosses a strategic red line and could escalate a regional conflict into a transatlantic security crisis. He added that this action would push European countries toward direct cooperation with the US. He also noted that the Islamic Republic might try to change the balance by attacking critical infrastructure or expanding the conflict, but this would ultimately broaden the coalition against it.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said that since the late 1970s, China has chosen the path of reforms and economic development instead of direct confrontation with the US to become a global power. He emphasized that the biggest rival of the US has built its power by strengthening its economy and national capabilities.

A leaked file from a secret Basij meeting in Pakdasht shows government forces preparing for a new round of protests. They are concerned about a possible increase in gasoline prices and public anger, and have instructed members to record and report protest activities. There is also concern about identifying suppressive forces using artificial intelligence.

Mike Huckabee, the US ambassador to Israel, said Iran has been hit hard twice and there is a possibility of US military action against Iran. Trump warned that if Iran does not abandon its nuclear ambitions and keep the Strait of Hormuz open, military conflict is possible. Huckabee said the final decision rests with Trump and he trusts his judgment.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the current governor of the Central Bank of the Islamic Republic, said the continuous US pressures on markets have also affected Iran's neighboring countries. He added that some of these neighbors refrain from taking photos or videos with officials of the Islamic Republic because they fear it would cause pressure on them.

Armin Shamsipour dedicated his gold medal at the Bratislava youth wrestling competition to all the hardworking laborers. He especially mentioned the difficulties faced by workers in Khuzestan due to extreme heat and power outages. Shamsipour hopes all workers will always be happy.

Donald Trump announced the start of the most severe economic operation against Iran. He warned that any country aiding Iran will face economic consequences. Trump also emphasized that Iran will never have nuclear weapons.

Jason Brodsky described the new economic action by the Trump administration against the Islamic Republic as a serious warning to China and its banks. He said this measure aims to counter Iran's circumvention of sanctions. He also noted that the UAE had acted before this message was published.

Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shibani said the Syrian government remains interested in reaching an agreement with Israel to reduce border tensions. He added that they were in contact with the Trump administration before and after the recent attack to prevent escalation. Al-Shibani also said they told the US they do not trust Israel's intentions and that Israel's current policy does not help Syria's stability.

Moderna and Merck announced that their personalized cancer vaccine reduced the risk of melanoma recurrence and spread in a late-stage trial. The mRNA-based vaccine is administered alongside the drug Keytruda. Five-year data shows this combination reduced melanoma recurrence risk by 50% and spread risk by 59%.

Israel targeted the Abu al-Duhur airbase in Syria with airstrikes four days after a phone call between the Mossad chief and the Syrian foreign minister. The attack occurred hours after a Turkish military delegation visited the base, aiming to prevent the expansion of Turkey's military presence in Syria. The US described the attack as an action that escalates tensions.

Malavan won against Zob Ahan in the second week of the Premier League after being behind, scoring two goals in the second half. Malavan's coach emphasized the important role of fans in this victory and said football is meaningless without spectators. The victory was celebrated at the Sirous Ghaeqran Stadium in Anzali.

Mizan news agency reported the execution of Ghaem Hosseini, a foreign national and protester of the Iranian National Revolution, in December 1404. His charges included brandishing a weapon, creating fear and terror, and acting against national security. The sentence was carried out in the Ali Khani Square case in Isfahan.

Omid Memarian stated that despite the US military superiority, the Islamic Republic still has the ability to disrupt the Strait of Hormuz. Washington's goal is to increase economic pressure to force the Islamic Republic to negotiate. He referred to Trump's remarks about the Strait of Hormuz being open and the success of the naval blockade.

Abbas Araghchi, Iran's foreign minister, described the US threat of economic operations against the Islamic Republic as a diversion of American public opinion from internal financial crises. He also stated that US economic terrorism threatens the global economy and the sovereignty of countries.

The US president announced that he will meet with Kim Jong-un late this year. He also said for the first time that North Korea has 57 'very powerful' nuclear weapons. These remarks came after Donald Trump's order to reduce joint US-South Korea military exercises.

A clinical trial shows that a personalized mRNA vaccine by Moderna and Merck, combined with the drug Keytruda, reduces the risk of recurrence and spread of the deadliest skin cancer by 50% and nearly 60%, respectively. Following the initial results, Moderna's stock value increased by nearly 177%. This report was provided by Niloufar Mansouri from Iran International.

Ali Dadpay referred to contradictory narratives about the release of Iran's blocked assets, stating that transferring 12 billion dollars or money and gold to Tehran does not mean trade facilitation. He added that Iran's banking system is isolated and the money transfer network faces serious restrictions. Also, under maritime blockade conditions, releasing these assets does not necessarily lead to increased supply or lower prices.

Qaim Hosseini, a detainee from the December 2025 protests in Isfahan, was executed today, August 29. He was tried and sentenced to death in the Ali Khani Square case in Isfahan. Previously, four other defendants in this case had also been executed.

The Syrian Foreign Minister denied plans to deploy Turkish forces at an airbase in Syria. He stated that Damascus is seeking an agreement with Israel to reduce border tensions. These remarks were made in an interview with Axios.

Ruhollah Rahimpour stated that Donald Trump's use of the term "economic war" against the Islamic Republic differs from previous sanctions. Earlier sanctions were mainly tools for punishing and restricting the government. Now economic pressure is used as a tool to force the Islamic Republic to accept the demands of the United States.

The Iran Chamber of Commerce Research Center reported that in 1404, the number of employed people decreased by about 770,000. Additionally, over 1,358,000 people left the labor market, and the number of social security insured individuals decreased by 611,000. The absolute poverty rate in 1403 was reported to be about 44 percent.
A 33-year-old woman in Parand was killed by her suitor because she rejected his marriage proposal. The suspect was arrested after the incident.

The Tehran Oil Refinery announced that thick smoke in southern Tehran was caused by an accident involving two tankers carrying kerosene and a fire at the loading site. No damage occurred to operational units, and activities continue. One person was injured in the incident, but their condition is not serious.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing that electricity was cut off in Eslamshahr on the evening of August 19. He stated that people's patience has run out and there is a risk of protests erupting soon.

Rouhollah Najabat, Shiraz representative, claimed the foreign influence countermeasure plan does not restrict citizens' communication abroad. However, communication with some countries requires permits and registration in a system supervised by security agencies. The plan also imposes special oversight on journalists, researchers, and economic activists.

Channel 14 Israel reported that the Islamic Republic has devised a two-stage offensive plan to counter US pressures. The first stage involves attacks on energy infrastructure and civilian facilities in the Gulf countries. If unsuccessful, the second stage will include extensive attacks on US military bases in the region.

Novak Djokovic shared his terrifying childhood memories during the Kosovo war in his new documentary. He described how his family had to flee during NATO's bombing of Belgrade in 1999. Djokovic called that night one of the first bombing nights and very frightening.

A video shows the father of Mohsen Abbasi shedding tears on Mount Damavand in mourning for his son. Mohsen Abbasi was killed on January 8, 2026, during protests in Najafabad, Isfahan. He was 21 years old.
A man in Noor County killed three members of his wife's family. The suspect stated family disputes as his motive after being arrested. This incident occurred in Noor County.

Abdulrahman Dawood reported increased tensions after Israel's attack on the Abu Zuhur base. Israel's concern over Turkey's expanding military presence in Syria is a main source of tension. Syrian officials do not rule out negotiations with Israel to prevent escalation.

Al Arabiya, citing official Yemeni military sources, reported that two Iranian Revolutionary Guard members and one Iraqi affiliated with them were killed in clashes with Yemeni government forces. These individuals were working as Revolutionary Guard experts in Yemen. Additionally, the commander of the Al-Fath Brigade was injured in a drone attack.
A 56-year-old citizen in Jahrom was arrested by law enforcement due to alleged connections with foreign media.

Iran International audiences have reported daily power outages and nighttime blackouts in streets and highways. Some citizens have also reported prolonged repeated water outages. One audience member said their refrigerator was damaged due to frequent power cuts.
Yaser Salarzehi, 18, and Ahmad Saqzehi, 26, died during a military chase in Bandar Abbas. Their vehicle caught fire after colliding with another car. This incident occurred early Thursday, August 29.

Mizan reported the execution of Ghaem Hosseini, an Afghan citizen and detainee of the December 2025 protests, in the Aliakhani Square case in Isfahan. Out of 59 detainees in this case, 12 were sentenced to death, and five death sentences have been carried out so far. The accused were denied a fair trial, and reports of torture and forced confessions have been published.

Volodymyr Zelensky announced that Russia launched a large-scale night attack targeting several regions of Ukraine with ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones. In the attacks on Kyiv, 13 people were killed and 40 injured. This report was provided by Ahmad Samadi from Iran International.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, met with senior Iraqi officials in Baghdad. Heybat al-Halbousi requested a special status for Iraq's oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz. The meetings emphasized strengthening bilateral relations and economic and security cooperation.

The Financial Times reported that the Islamic Republic has examined attacking US military targets in Europe if the war escalates. The known range of some of the Islamic Republic's missiles reaches about 2,000 kilometers, putting southern and southeastern Europe within the threat range. However, experts say the Islamic Republic may have missiles with a range of over 2,000 kilometers, but the number, accuracy, and ability of these missiles to penetrate defenses are unclear.

The prosecutor of South Khorasan announced the closure of 10 cafes and restaurants and the seizure of 28 motorcycles due to non-compliance with mandatory hijab. Additionally, information of 70 cars has been recorded. These actions have been taken since the beginning of the current year.

UEFA, AFC, and CONCACAF are considering a vote of no confidence against FIFA president Infantino. This move follows Infantino's controversial plan to sell shares of a new FIFA commercial entity and transfer World Cup commercial rights. The three confederations have criticized Infantino's management for lack of transparency and governance weaknesses.

Early Thursday morning, August 29, a chase involving military forces in Bandar Abbas resulted in a collision and fire of a fuel smuggler's vehicle. Two fuel smugglers lost their lives in this incident. The event occurred during a military operation.

In the second week of the Persian Gulf Pro League, Persepolis defeated Esteghlal Khuzestan 4-1. Persepolis topped the table with six points and a better goal difference than Esteghlal. The match was held at Ghal'eh Hasan Khan Stadium.

Jamshid Molaei, a relative of Kian Pirfalak, a child killed during the 1401 protests, was arrested in the city of Izeh. The arrest took place one week after the reconstruction of Kian's grave, and no reason has been given. Jamshid Molaei suffers from diabetes.

The judiciary of the Islamic Republic executed Ghaem Hosseini in connection with the December protests in Isfahan. He is the fifth person executed in the Ali Khani Square case. The death sentence was carried out after being confirmed by the Supreme Court.

Tankers Tracker company announced that five million barrels of oil pass daily through the US naval blockade line in the Strait of Hormuz. The loading location does not affect this amount. Kepler's data shows that cargo ship traffic in the Strait of Hormuz remains very low.

Abbas Araghchi described Donald Trump's threat to start an economic campaign against Iran as an attempt to cover up internal crises in the US. He cited unprecedented debts and rising interest costs as examples of these crises. Araghchi also called Trump's statements miscalculations and signs of a bigger failure.

The CEO of the Tabriz Passenger Transport Management Organization announced that out of 10,700 active taxis, 5,371 are worn out and no taxis have been renewed this year. The average age of BRT buses has reached 13 years, and the number of buses has decreased. Additionally, waiting times on suburban lines can reach 40 minutes, and there is a lack of financial resources for fleet development.

Israel attacked the Abu al-Duhur military airport near Aleppo. The attack was a warning to the Syrian government about Turkey's expanding influence. Israeli officials consider Turkey's military presence in Syria a red line.

Parnian Dabiri, a 16-year-old girl, was transferred to Kahrizak after being shot, and her body was found on the asphalt. Her mother said she was threatened and struck by officers while trying to retrieve the body. The family demands accountability for Parnian's death.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations center reported that six armed individuals boarded an oil tanker in the Gulf of Aden and took control. They are redirecting the tanker towards Somalia. Authorities are investigating the incident and have urged vessels to exercise caution.

Daily wage workers dismissed from Amir Kabir Petrochemical Company held a protest in the special economic zone and petrochemical area of Sarbandar in Mahshahr. These workers are protesting their job uncertainty. They demand to be reinstated at the company.
Nazanin Hosseinpour, a citizen from Piranshahr, has been detained by intelligence officers for five days. There is still no information about her place of detention. Her condition remains unknown.

Roberto Carlos denied rumors about his conversion to Islam. He stated that he respects Islam but has not converted. His wedding ceremony included different rituals to accommodate both Catholic and Muslim families.

A video shows the missing husband of Zahra Najafi visiting her grave in Mashhad, kissing and decorating the tombstone with flowers. The accompanying note states that after 12 years of waiting to reunite, he lost her again.

The head of the Agricultural Commission of the Parliament stated that the Ministry of Agriculture intended to extend the expiration date of 20,000 tons of expired chicken without testing. Some of these chickens have entered the market, and pressure was applied to the Veterinary Organization to change the expiration date. This issue has been reported to the General Inspection Organization and the President.

The US Central Command announced that the USS George Washington carrier strike group has entered its operational area in the Middle East. This strike group was deployed to the region as part of a planned mission. CENTCOM also released an image of the carrier's deck in the Arabian Sea.
Iliya Dehqani was shot with a military bullet in Tehranpars on the evening of January 8. The incident resulted in his spinal cord being severed. After about a week of hospitalization, he died.

Relatives of a prisoner sentenced to death gathered today in front of Khorramabad prison. They protested with slogans demanding the halt of Mohammad Rezaei's death sentence. The gathering took place on August 20.

Hossein Aghaei stated that after the fall of Assad's regime, Turkey aims to expand its influence in Syria. This process is accompanied by a decline in Russian influence and weakening of the Islamic Republic. Israel views this expansion as a threat to its freedom of action and air superiority in Syria.

Asaad Hassan Al-Shibani, the Syrian Foreign Minister, traveled to Islamabad. This is the first visit by a high-ranking Syrian official after the change of government in Syria. He met with his Pakistani counterpart, Muhammad Ishaq Dar, to discuss expanding bilateral relations.

A citizen in Tehran reported seeing a fuel tanker with the words "My tanker is empty, I have no gasoline to sell" written on it. The tanker driver said he put up the sign due to repeated requests from people for gasoline.

Miad Maleki, former head of the US Treasury Department's sanctions targeting office, said the Islamic Republic's strength lies more in creating short-term crises than winning long-term conflicts. He added that this situation has become more apparent due to increased pressure from regional countries and Tehran's narrowing options.

The spokesperson of Yemen's armed forces announced that 81 operations were carried out against the Houthis within 24 hours. Several field commanders and a number of Houthi forces were killed in these operations. The Yemeni armed forces also stated they will not allow foreign agendas to be executed on Yemeni soil.

Ehsan Shams Beigi, detained during the December 2025 protests, has been held in Adl Abad Prison in Shiraz for over seven months without a clear status. His case, initially charged with crimes such as waging war and propaganda against the regime, was referred to the Revolutionary Court but then sent back for further investigation after the charges were dismissed. During detention, he has been pressured and threatened to obtain forced confessions.

The committee monitoring the detainees' situation announced that those arrested during the National Iranian Revolution in Sari face charges of waging war against God and corruption on earth. Nikky Mahjoub stated that the Islamic Republic does not follow legal procedures in handling the detainees' cases. The fate of the detainees largely depends on the case officers.

American officials say negotiations between Iran and Oman regarding tolls for passage through the Strait of Hormuz have been halted in recent days. Donald Trump stated that the Islamic Republic did not use the opportunity to reach an agreement, so the United States will begin the heaviest economic operation against Iran.

The mother of Parnian Dabiri emphasized continuing the pursuit of justice for her daughter in a video message. She stated that security forces assaulted and insulted her while she tried to receive her daughter's body. Parnian Dabiri, 16 years old, died during protests in Tehran.

Donald Trump has warned countries and companies that continue trading with Iran. He said these countries may face economic consequences. This threat comes as the maritime blockade of Iran has affected the country's foreign trade.

Khatoun Bam drew 1-1 against Al Nassr Saudi Arabia in the second week of the AFC Women's Champions League qualifiers. Al Nassr scored first from a penalty, and Sara Didar equalized in the 95th minute. Khatoun Bam still has a chance to advance from Group E.

Yahya Sari, spokesperson for the Yemeni Houthis, announced that the group targeted Najran airport and Aramco facilities with two drones. He said both operations were successful and the attacks were in response to Saudi drones violating Saada province's airspace. He also emphasized that they will continue to counter any violations of Yemen's sovereignty.

A group of hospital staff from Neyshabur University of Medical Sciences held a protest on Tuesday near 22 Bahman Hospital. They protested against their living conditions, salary calculations, and payments of tariffs, bonuses, and overtime.

Heybat al-Halbousi, the Speaker of the Iraqi Parliament, reacted to a photo published by Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf by posting an image in which the name of the Persian Gulf was changed. Ghalibaf met with senior Iraqi officials in Baghdad on Wednesday, August 19. Halbousi called for a special status for Iraq's oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz.

Abulfazl Saedi, a detainee from the national revolution in Shahroud, was executed by the government on the early morning of Tuesday, June 16. A video shows his mother mourning and crying at his grave on Thursday. This video was released by Iran International.

Hamidreza Hajibabaei said that anyone who keeps oil prices high helps the Islamic Republic. He added that countries creating alternative pipelines to help the US lower oil prices are effectively fighting against the Islamic Republic. He also emphasized that the Islamic Republic should prevent the creation of pipelines and oil exports through these routes.

Denmark has banned Mansour Loghayi, an Iranian Shia cleric, from entering the country due to his views on women and marital relations. He previously collaborated with the Imam Ali Mosque in Copenhagen. This mosque has been controversial for its connections to the Islamic Republic.

Iran's Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the new US economic sanctions as economic terrorism and crimes against humanity. The ministry held the US responsible for the consequences of the sanctions. It also stated it will continue to resist US pressures.

Ata Hosseinian, an economic journalist, stated that the fuel targeting plan pursued by the Islamic Republic has never brought more justice to society. He made this statement in an interview with Iran International.

Scott Bassett, the US Treasury Secretary, stated that Washington intends to impose the toughest sanctions in history against the Islamic Republic. He said these sanctions will limit the Islamic Republic's ability to act through proxy forces. Bassett added that maximum economic pressure might mean no resumption of military conflict.

Ali Bahraini, Iran's representative at the United Nations, stated at the Disarmament Conference that the US efforts to gain military superiority in space increase the risk of militarization. He added that the development of US space military capabilities could escalate the arms race.

In Kashan, contrary to Iran's international commitments under the Convention on the Rights of the Child, children and adolescents have been trained in the use and carrying of weapons, including war weapons. Published images show that weapons were given to some children. This action violates Iran's commitments regarding the non-use of children in military activities.

Varzesh3 released a video of the national freestyle wrestling team's training under Alireza Dabir. In the video, Dabir forces wrestlers to push each other uphill on dirt mounds. Previously, a video showed him using a garden hose to help wrestlers recover.

Women motorcyclists continue to face difficulties in obtaining licenses and insurance coverage. This situation deprives them of legal recourse and compensation in case of accidents. Some women have also reported street harassment and humiliating behavior.

A video of Bachtawar Kazakoff's anti-Semitic conversation at the Esther and Mordechai tomb in Hamadan sparked anger among Iranians. Following protests, the tourist deleted the video from Instagram and apologized to the Iranian people.

Ronaldinho, the former Brazilian football star, joins Ravenna in Italy's third division at age 46, 11 years after retiring. He will become a shareholder of the club and plans to play in an official match for Ravenna. His introduction ceremony will be held tonight with about six thousand fans attending.

Pierre Poilievre, leader of Canada's Conservative Party, announced his conversation with Prince Reza Pahlavi and invited him to visit Canada. They discussed international pressure on the Islamic Republic and support for the Iranian people. It was also emphasized that Iran's future should be determined by Iranians through free elections.

CENTCOM announced that the USS Boxer continues to enforce the US blockade against Iran in the Arabian Sea. By August 20, US forces have altered the course of 67 commercial ships, disabled three ships, and boarded two ships. Images of MV-22B Osprey aircraft taking off from the deck of this ship were released.

Ghazal Marzban, a transgender woman imprisoned in Evin, reported sexual assault in a Ministry of Intelligence detention center in a letter. She stated that after her arrest in May 2023, she was assaulted and threatened to remain silent. Marzban also mentioned her re-arrest in December 2025 and her fear of the incident recurring.

Mehdi Taremi attended Olympiacos training for the last time on Thursday and said goodbye to the club members. He will go to Dubai to complete his transfer to Al Wasl in the UAE. Olympiacos is also making changes in their attack line following his departure.

Emad Rafiei reported an increase in gasoline imbalance in Iran, with production capacity at about 130 million liters per day. Recent consumption has risen to around 153 million liters per day. Iran now spends about three billion dollars on gasoline imports, whereas it previously earned revenue from exports.
A citizen in Mazandaran province sent a video showing that traffic police officers of the law enforcement in this province confiscated a woman's motorcycle on a street in Amol.
